title: Protocols for analysis of mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening in mouse somatic cell reprogramming
protocol: Coat 35 mm dish with 1 mL gelatin for at least 0.5 h at 37°C.
Remove the gelatin from the coated dish.
Plate MEFs at 40,000 cells per dish.
Gently place the dish into a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 24 h to allow cell attachment.
Dilute MEFs in 1 mL culture medium before plating to ensure even distribution.
Mix the diluted cells well and add them to the dish.
Rock the dish gently to distribute the cells evenly.
Infect MEFs with SKOM retroviruses.
Remove the medium and add 2.5 mL SKOM viral supernatants to dish.
Incubate for 24 hours.
Repeat infection process for another round of 24 hours.
Wash cells twice with modified HBSS buffer.
Incubate cells in 1 mL labeling solution for 15 min protected from light at 37°C.
Wash cells with 1 mL warm modified HBSS buffer to remove residual dye and minimize background.
Prepare stock solution of calcein-AM (1 mM) with DMSO.
Mix stock solutions to prepare labeling solution.
Label cells for imaging as described in step 5.
Image cells with Zeiss LSM710 using Calcein: Ex 488 and Emi 509; DAPI: Ex 405 and Emi 420.
Image the morphology changed cells which are reprogramming cells at days 3, 5 and 8 during reprogramming process.
Prepare four dishes for mPTP opening analysis.
Carry out mPTP opening analysis at days 0, 3, 5 and 8 during reprogramming.
After quickly thawing MEFs in a 37°C water bath, immediately transfer the thawed cell into a 15 mL tube containing 5 mL of fibroblast medium.
Centrifuge the tube for 5 min at 200 g.
Discard the supernatant and transfer the cell to a 10 cm dish with 10 mL fibroblast medium.
Use 1 mL DPBS to wash cells once.
Add 1 mL of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA at 37°C for 2 minutes.
Add 1 mL of fibroblast medium, suspend MEFs and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 200 g.
Suspend MEFs with modified HBSS buffer (negative control) or labeling solution without Hoechst at a final concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Incubate the suspension protected from light at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Wash labeled cells with 1 mL modified HBSS buffer and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 200 g.
Repeat washing twice to remove residual dye and minimize fluorescent background.
Resuspend MEFs in DPBS buffer containing 2% BSA.
Sort the mPTP opening cells based on calcein fluorescence intensity.
Prepare medium-filled tubes to collect sorted cells before sorting.
Coat a 12-well plate with gelatin for cell attachment after sorting.
Set sorting parameters of flow cytometry with 488 nm excitation.
Gate appropriate cells without debris (gate R1 and R2).
Proceed to gate low (R3) and high (R4) calcein fluorescence intensity cells in G2.
Sort cells with low and high calcein fluorescence intensity for high and low mPTP opening, respectively.
Plate sorted high and low mPTP opening cells onto a 12-well plate.
Incubate plates for 12 hours to allow cell attachment.
Infect the cells with SKOM retroviruses as previously described.
Count GFP-positive iPSC colonies at day 15 to determine reprogramming efficiency.
